name: @pipeworx/mcp-climatiq

tools.name: search_factors
tools.description: Search Climatiq's emission-factor database. Use to discover factor IDs and required parameters before calling estimate_emissions. Filter by query, category, source (e.g., "EPA", "DEFRA"), region (ISO code), or year.

unit_type.description: Activity unit type (Energy, Volume, Distance, Mass, etc.)

tools.name: estimate_emissions
tools.description: Calculate kgCO₂e for an activity. Pass an emission_factor with at minimum `activity_id` (from search_factors) or `id`, plus the required `parameters` (e.g., `{ energy: 200, energy_unit: "kWh" }`). Returns CO₂e + breakdown.

emission_factor.description: Selector object — at minimum {activity_id: "..."} or {id: "..."}. May add region, year, source for disambiguation.

parameters.description: Activity quantities matching the factor's required unit type (e.g., {energy:200, energy_unit:"kWh"}).

tools.name: list_unit_types
tools.description: List supported unit-type families (Energy / Volume / Distance / Mass / etc.) and their valid units.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-climatiq forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the climatiq pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
